verses.text: <ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>基<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jī</rt></ruby><ruby>督<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dū</rt></ruby><ruby>福<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby><ruby>音<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tóu</rt></ruby>。
verses.heading: 施洗约翰传道

verses.text: <ruby>正<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>先<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiān</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>赛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sài</rt></ruby><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yà</rt></ruby></mark>（<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>古<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>卷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">juàn</rt></ruby><ruby>无<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wú</rt></ruby>“<ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>赛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sài</rt></ruby><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yà</rt></ruby>”<ruby>三<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sān</rt></ruby><ruby>字<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby>）<ruby>书<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shū</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shɑnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>记<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>哪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>差<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chāi</rt></ruby><ruby>遣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>者<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhě</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>预<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yù</rt></ruby><ruby>备<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>路<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zài</rt></ruby><ruby>旷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>野<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>声<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>喊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：‘<ruby>预<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yù</rt></ruby><ruby>备<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby>，<ruby>修<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiū</rt></ruby><ruby>直<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhí</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>路<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby>。’”

<ruby>照<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhào</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby>，<mark class="pn"><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>翰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hàn</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>，<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>旷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>野<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>施<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shī</rt></ruby><ruby>洗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>传<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuán</rt></ruby><ruby>悔<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>改<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>洗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>礼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>罪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuì</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>赦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shè</rt></ruby>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>犹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yóu</rt></ruby><ruby>太<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tài</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>全<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">quán</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>路<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby><ruby>撒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sā</rt></ruby><ruby>冷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lěnɡ</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>翰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hàn</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>承<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>认<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rèn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>罪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>旦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dàn</rt></ruby><ruby>河<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>受<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shòu</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>洗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐ</rt></ruby>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>翰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hàn</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>穿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuān</rt></ruby><ruby>骆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">luò</rt></ruby><ruby>驼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tuo</rt></ruby><ruby>毛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">máo</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>衣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>服<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>腰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yāo</rt></ruby><ruby>束<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shù</rt></ruby><ruby>皮<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pí</rt></ruby><ruby>带<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby>，<ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>蝗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>虫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chónɡ</rt></ruby>、<ruby>野<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>蜜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mì</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>传<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuán</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>位<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>后<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>力<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>比<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>更<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>弯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wān</rt></ruby><ruby>腰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yāo</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>解<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiě</rt></ruby><ruby>鞋<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xié</rt></ruby><ruby>带<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>配<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pèi</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>水<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>施<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shī</rt></ruby><ruby>洗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>却<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">què</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>圣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>灵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">línɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>施<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shī</rt></ruby><ruby>洗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐ</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nà</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby>，<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>加<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>拿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Ná</rt></ruby><ruby>撒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sā</rt></ruby><ruby>勒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>旦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dàn</rt></ruby><ruby>河<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>受<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shòu</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>翰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hàn</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>洗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐ</rt></ruby>。
verses.heading: 耶稣受洗

verses.text: <ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>水<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiān</rt></ruby><ruby>裂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby><ruby>开<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kāi</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>，<ruby>圣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>灵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">línɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>仿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>佛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby><ruby>鸽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡē</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>降<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>身<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>声<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>音<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiān</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>爱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ài</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>喜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>悦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuè</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>圣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>灵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">línɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>催<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cuī</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>旷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>野<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>。
verses.heading: 耶稣受试探

verses.text: <ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>旷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>野<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>四<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sì</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiān</rt></ruby>，<ruby>受<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shòu</rt></ruby><ruby>撒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sā</rt></ruby><ruby>但<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dàn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>试<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>探<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tàn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>野<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>兽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shòu</rt></ruby><ruby>同<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>处<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>且<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiě</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiān</rt></ruby><ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>伺<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cì</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>翰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hàn</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby><ruby>监<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>后<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>加<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby></mark>，<ruby>宣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xuān</rt></ruby><ruby>传<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuán</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>福<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby><ruby>音<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby>，
verses.heading: 开始在加利利传道

verses.text: <ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>日<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Rì</rt></ruby><ruby>期<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qī</rt></ruby><ruby>满<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>，　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>国<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuó</rt></ruby><ruby>近<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>悔<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>改<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǎi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>信<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìn</rt></ruby><ruby>福<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby><ruby>音<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby>！”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>顺<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shùn</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>加<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>海<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>边<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biān</rt></ruby><ruby>走<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǒu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xī</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xī</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>兄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>弟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>安<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Ān</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>烈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>海<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>撒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>网<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǎnɡ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>本<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">běn</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>打<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>鱼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。

verses.text: <ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Lái</rt></ruby><ruby>跟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡēn</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>鱼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>立<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>刻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kè</rt></ruby><ruby>舍<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shě</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>网<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǎnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>跟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡēn</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>稍<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shāo</rt></ruby><ruby>往<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby><ruby>走<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǒu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xī</rt></ruby><ruby>庇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>太<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tài</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>雅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>各<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>雅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>各<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>兄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>弟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>翰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hàn</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>船<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuán</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>补<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>网<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǎnɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>随<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suí</rt></ruby><ruby>即<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jí</rt></ruby><ruby>招<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhāo</rt></ruby><ruby>呼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hu</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>父<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>亲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qīn</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xī</rt></ruby><ruby>庇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>太<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tài</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>雇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡù</rt></ruby><ruby>工<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>留<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liú</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>船<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuán</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>跟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡēn</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dào</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>迦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>百<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>农<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nónɡ</rt></ruby></mark>，<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>安<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ān</rt></ruby><ruby>息<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby><ruby>日<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rì</rt></ruby><ruby>进<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>会<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huì</rt></ruby><ruby>堂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>教<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>训<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xùn</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>。

verses.text: <ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>很<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hěn</rt></ruby><ruby>希<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby><ruby>奇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>教<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>训<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xùn</rt></ruby>；<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>教<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>训<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xùn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>，<ruby>正<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>像<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>权<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">quán</rt></ruby><ruby>柄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>像<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>文<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wén</rt></ruby><ruby>士<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zài</rt></ruby><ruby>会<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huì</rt></ruby><ruby>堂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>污<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wū</rt></ruby><ruby>鬼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>附<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhuó</rt></ruby>。<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>喊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：

“<mark class="pn"><ruby>拿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Ná</rt></ruby><ruby>撒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sā</rt></ruby><ruby>勒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>相<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>干<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡān</rt></ruby>？<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>灭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miè</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>吗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mɑ</rt></ruby>？<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>谁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuí</rt></ruby>，<ruby>乃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>圣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>者<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhě</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>责<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zé</rt></ruby><ruby>备<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bú</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>声<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby>！<ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>身<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>吧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bɑ</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>污<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wū</rt></ruby><ruby>鬼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>抽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chōu</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>阵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhèn</rt></ruby><ruby>风<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>声<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>喊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>惊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>讶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yà</rt></ruby>，<ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>致<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>彼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>此<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>问<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèn</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>？<ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shì</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>新<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>理<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>！<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>权<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">quán</rt></ruby><ruby>柄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>吩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēn</rt></ruby><ruby>咐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>污<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wū</rt></ruby><ruby>鬼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>连<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lián</rt></ruby><ruby>污<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wū</rt></ruby><ruby>鬼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>名<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>声<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>传<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuán</rt></ruby><ruby>遍<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>加<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>四<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sì</rt></ruby><ruby>方<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fānɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>进<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>屋<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wū</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>聚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jù</rt></ruby><ruby>集<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jí</rt></ruby>，<ruby>甚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shèn</rt></ruby><ruby>至<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>连<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lián</rt></ruby><ruby>饭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fàn</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>顾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡù</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby>。
