verses.text: <ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>亲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qīn</rt></ruby><ruby>属<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lā</rt></ruby><ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>癫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diān</rt></ruby><ruby>狂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Cónɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>路<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby><ruby>撒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sā</rt></ruby><ruby>冷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lěnɡ</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>文<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wén</rt></ruby><ruby>士<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>别<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bié</rt></ruby><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xī</rt></ruby><ruby>卜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>附<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhuó</rt></ruby>”；<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>靠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kào</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>鬼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>王<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>赶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>鬼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǐ</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>比<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>喻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yù</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>撒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Sā</rt></ruby><ruby>但<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dàn</rt></ruby><ruby>怎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zěn</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>赶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>撒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sā</rt></ruby><ruby>但<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dàn</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？

<ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>国<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuó</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>相<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>纷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēn</rt></ruby><ruby>争<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhēnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>国<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuó</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>站<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhàn</rt></ruby><ruby>立<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby>；

<ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>家<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>相<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>纷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēn</rt></ruby><ruby>争<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhēnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>家<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>站<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhàn</rt></ruby><ruby>立<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>撒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sā</rt></ruby><ruby>但<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dàn</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>相<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>攻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>打<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>纷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēn</rt></ruby><ruby>争<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhēnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>站<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhàn</rt></ruby><ruby>立<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>灭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miè</rt></ruby><ruby>亡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wánɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>进<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>壮<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhuànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>士<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>家<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>抢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>夺<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duó</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>家<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>具<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jù</rt></ruby>；<ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>先<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiān</rt></ruby><ruby>捆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǔn</rt></ruby><ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>壮<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhuànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>士<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>才<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cái</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>抢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>夺<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duó</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>家<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>实<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby><ruby>诉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">su</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>，<ruby>世<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>切<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiè</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>罪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuì</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>切<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiè</rt></ruby><ruby>亵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiè</rt></ruby><ruby>渎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dú</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>赦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shè</rt></ruby><ruby>免<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miǎn</rt></ruby>；

<ruby>凡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fán</rt></ruby><ruby>亵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiè</rt></ruby><ruby>渎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dú</rt></ruby><ruby>圣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>灵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">línɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>却<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">què</rt></ruby><ruby>永<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>赦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shè</rt></ruby><ruby>免<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miǎn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>乃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>担<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dān</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>永<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>远<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>罪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuì</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>污<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wū</rt></ruby><ruby>鬼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>附<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhuó</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby>，<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>母<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>亲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qīn</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>弟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>兄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>站<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhàn</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>外<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wài</rt></ruby><ruby>边<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biɑn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>打<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fā</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>。
verses.heading: 耶稣的母亲和兄弟们

verses.text: <ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>许<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>多<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duō</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>周<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōu</rt></ruby><ruby>围<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>坐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby><ruby>诉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">su</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>哪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>母<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>亲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qīn</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>弟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>兄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>外<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wài</rt></ruby><ruby>边<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biɑn</rt></ruby><ruby>找<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><ruby>答<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dá</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>谁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shuí</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>母<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>亲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qīn</rt></ruby>？<ruby>谁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shuí</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>弟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>兄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiōnɡ</rt></ruby>？”

<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>四<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sì</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>观<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuān</rt></ruby><ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>周<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōu</rt></ruby><ruby>围<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>坐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>哪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>母<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>亲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qīn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>弟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>兄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiōnɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>凡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Fán</rt></ruby><ruby>遵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zūn</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>旨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>意<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>弟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>兄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>姐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiě</rt></ruby><ruby>妹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mèi</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>母<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>亲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qīn</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>海<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>边<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biān</rt></ruby><ruby>教<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>训<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xùn</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>。<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>许<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>多<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duō</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>聚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jù</rt></ruby><ruby>集<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jí</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>只<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>船<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuán</rt></ruby><ruby>坐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby>。<ruby>船<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Chuán</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>海<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>靠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kào</rt></ruby><ruby>近<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>海<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>站<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhàn</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>岸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">àn</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>。
verses.heading: 撒种的比喻

verses.text: <ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>比<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>喻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yù</rt></ruby><ruby>教<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>训<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xùn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>许<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>多<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duō</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>理<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>。<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zài</rt></ruby><ruby>教<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>训<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xùn</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>间<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby>，<ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：

“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>！<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>撒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>种<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>撒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>种<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒnɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>撒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby>，<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>落<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">luò</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>路<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby><ruby>旁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>飞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēi</rt></ruby><ruby>鸟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby><ruby>尽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>；

<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>落<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">luò</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>土<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>浅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>石<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tou</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>土<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>既<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>深<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fā</rt></ruby><ruby>苗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miáo</rt></ruby><ruby>最<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuì</rt></ruby><ruby>快<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuài</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>日<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rì</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tou</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>晒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shài</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>根<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡēn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>枯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kū</rt></ruby><ruby>干<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡān</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>；

<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>落<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">luò</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>荆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>棘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jí</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>荆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>棘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jí</rt></ruby><ruby>长<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>它<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>挤<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>结<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiē</rt></ruby><ruby>实<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby>；

<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>落<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">luò</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>土<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fā</rt></ruby><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>长<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby>，<ruby>结<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiē</rt></ruby><ruby>实<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>三<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sān</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>倍<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>六<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liù</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>倍<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>百<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>倍<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>”；

<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>耳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ěr</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>应<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby>！”

<ruby>无<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wú</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby>，<ruby>跟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡēn</rt></ruby><ruby>随<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suí</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>二<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">èr</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>徒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tú</rt></ruby><ruby>问<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>比<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>喻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yù</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>意<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>思<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">si</rt></ruby>。
verses.heading: 用比喻的目的

verses.text: <ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>国<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuó</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>奥<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ào</rt></ruby><ruby>秘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mì</rt></ruby><ruby>只<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby>，<ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>外<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wài</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>讲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǎnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>凡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fán</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>比<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>喻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yù</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>却<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">què</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>晓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>；<ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>却<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">què</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>明<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>白<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bɑi</rt></ruby>；<ruby>恐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Kǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>怕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pà</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><ruby>转<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhuǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>赦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shè</rt></ruby><ruby>免<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miǎn</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>明<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>白<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bɑi</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>比<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>喻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yù</rt></ruby><ruby>吗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mɑ</rt></ruby>？<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>怎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zěn</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>明<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>白<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bɑi</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>切<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiè</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>比<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>喻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yù</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？
verses.heading: 解明撒种的比喻

verses.text: <ruby>撒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Sǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>种<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>撒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nà</rt></ruby><ruby>撒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sā</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>路<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby><ruby>旁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby>，<ruby>撒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sā</rt></ruby><ruby>但<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dàn</rt></ruby><ruby>立<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>刻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kè</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>撒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sā</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>夺<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duó</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>撒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>石<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tou</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby>，<ruby>立<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>刻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kè</rt></ruby><ruby>欢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huān</rt></ruby><ruby>喜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>领<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>受<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shòu</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>但<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dàn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>根<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡēn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>暂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zàn</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>及<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jí</rt></ruby><ruby>至<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>遭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zāo</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>患<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huàn</rt></ruby><ruby>难<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nàn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>或<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huò</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>受<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shòu</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>逼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bī</rt></ruby><ruby>迫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pò</rt></ruby>，<ruby>立<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>刻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kè</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>跌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diē</rt></ruby><ruby>倒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>还<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hái</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>撒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>荆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>棘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jí</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>后<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>世<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>思<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sī</rt></ruby><ruby>虑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǜ</rt></ruby>、<ruby>钱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby><ruby>财<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cái</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>迷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mí</rt></ruby><ruby>惑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huò</rt></ruby>，<ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>别<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bié</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>私<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sī</rt></ruby><ruby>欲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yù</rt></ruby><ruby>进<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>挤<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>结<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiē</rt></ruby><ruby>实<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>撒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby>，<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>领<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>受<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shòu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>且<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiě</rt></ruby><ruby>结<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiē</rt></ruby><ruby>实<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby>，<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>三<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sān</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>倍<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>六<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liù</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>倍<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>百<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>倍<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Rén</rt></ruby><ruby>拿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ná</rt></ruby><ruby>灯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>岂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>放<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>斗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dòu</rt></ruby><ruby>底<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>床<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>底<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>放<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>灯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>台<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tái</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>吗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mɑ</rt></ruby>？
verses.heading: 斗底下的灯

verses.text: <ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>掩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>藏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>显<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>；<ruby>隐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐn</rt></ruby><ruby>瞒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mán</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>露<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>耳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ěr</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>应<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby>！”

<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>留<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liú</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby>。<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>量<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>器<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qì</rt></ruby><ruby>量<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>量<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>器<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qì</rt></ruby><ruby>量<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>，<ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>且<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiě</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>多<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duō</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>还<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hái</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>；<ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>连<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lián</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>夺<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duó</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>国<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuó</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>同<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>种<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>撒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>。
verses.heading: 种子长大的比喻

verses.text: <ruby>黑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Hēi</rt></ruby><ruby>夜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yè</rt></ruby><ruby>睡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuì</rt></ruby><ruby>觉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby>，<ruby>白<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bái</rt></ruby><ruby>日<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rì</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>种<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fā</rt></ruby><ruby>芽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yá</rt></ruby><ruby>渐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>长<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǎnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>却<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">què</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>晓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>何<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dì</rt></ruby><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>五<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>谷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>于<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>然<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rán</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>：<ruby>先<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiān</rt></ruby><ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fā</rt></ruby><ruby>苗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miáo</rt></ruby>，<ruby>后<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby><ruby>长<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>穗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>再<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>后<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby><ruby>穗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suì</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>结<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jié</rt></ruby><ruby>成<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>饱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>满<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>粒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby>；

<ruby>谷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Gǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>既<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>熟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shú</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>镰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lián</rt></ruby><ruby>刀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dāo</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>割<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡē</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>收<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shōu</rt></ruby><ruby>成<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>国<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuó</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>比<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>较<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？<ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Kě</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>比<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>喻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yù</rt></ruby><ruby>表<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>明<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？
verses.heading: 芥菜种的比喻

verses.text: <ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Hǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>像<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>粒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>芥<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiè</rt></ruby><ruby>菜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cài</rt></ruby><ruby>种<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>种<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby>，<ruby>虽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suī</rt></ruby><ruby>比<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>百<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>种<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>小<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎo</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>但<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dàn</rt></ruby><ruby>种<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>后<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>长<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>比<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>各<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>菜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cài</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby>，<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>长<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>枝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>甚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shèn</rt></ruby><ruby>至<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiān</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>飞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēi</rt></ruby><ruby>鸟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>宿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sù</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>它<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>荫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>许<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>多<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duō</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>比<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>喻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>照<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhào</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>讲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby>。
verses.heading: 耶稣用比喻讲道

verses.text: <ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>比<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>喻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>讲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǎnɡ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>切<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiè</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>讲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>徒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tú</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiān</rt></ruby><ruby>晚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>徒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tú</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>渡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dù</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>边<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biān</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>吧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bɑ</rt></ruby>。”
verses.heading: 平静风和海

verses.text: <ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mén</rt></ruby><ruby>徒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tú</rt></ruby><ruby>离<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lí</rt></ruby><ruby>开<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kāi</rt></ruby><ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>仍<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>船<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuán</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>同<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>带<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>；<ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>别<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bié</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>船<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuán</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>同<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>忽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Hū</rt></ruby><ruby>然<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rán</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>暴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bào</rt></ruby><ruby>风<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>波<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bō</rt></ruby><ruby>浪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>打<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>入<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rù</rt></ruby><ruby>船<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuán</rt></ruby><ruby>内<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nèi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>甚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shèn</rt></ruby><ruby>至<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>船<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuán</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>满<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>水<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuǐ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>船<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuán</rt></ruby><ruby>尾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wěi</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>枕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhěn</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>枕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhěn</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tou</rt></ruby><ruby>睡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuì</rt></ruby><ruby>觉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby>。<ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mén</rt></ruby><ruby>徒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tú</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>醒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>夫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Fū</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby>！<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>丧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>命<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mìnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>顾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡù</rt></ruby><ruby>吗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mɑ</rt></ruby>？”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>醒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>，<ruby>斥<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chì</rt></ruby><ruby>责<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zé</rt></ruby><ruby>风<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>海<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>吧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bɑ</rt></ruby>！<ruby>静<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>吧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bɑ</rt></ruby>！”<ruby>风<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Fēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>止<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>平<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>静<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>胆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>怯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiè</rt></ruby>？<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>还<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hái</rt></ruby><ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>信<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìn</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>吗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mɑ</rt></ruby>？”

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby>地<ruby>惧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jù</rt></ruby><ruby>怕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pà</rt></ruby>，<ruby>彼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>此<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>底<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>谁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuí</rt></ruby>，<ruby>连<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lián</rt></ruby><ruby>风<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>海<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>海<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>边<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biān</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>格<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Gé</rt></ruby><ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lā</rt></ruby><ruby>森<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sēn</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>方<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fɑnɡ</rt></ruby>。

verses.text: <ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby><ruby>船<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuán</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>污<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wū</rt></ruby><ruby>鬼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>附<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhuó</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>坟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fén</rt></ruby><ruby>茔<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>迎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nà</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>常<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>坟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fén</rt></ruby><ruby>茔<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>捆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǔn</rt></ruby><ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>铁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiě</rt></ruby><ruby>链<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liàn</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby>；

<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>屡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǚ</rt></ruby><ruby>次<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cì</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>脚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>镣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liào</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>铁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiě</rt></ruby><ruby>链<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liàn</rt></ruby><ruby>捆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǔn</rt></ruby><ruby>锁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>铁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiě</rt></ruby><ruby>链<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liàn</rt></ruby><ruby>竟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>挣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>断<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duàn</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>，<ruby>脚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>镣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liào</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>弄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>碎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suì</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>；<ruby>总<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>制<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>伏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>昼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhòu</rt></ruby><ruby>夜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yè</rt></ruby><ruby>常<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>坟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fén</rt></ruby><ruby>茔<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>山<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shān</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>喊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby>，<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>石<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tou</rt></ruby><ruby>砍<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>己<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>远<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>远<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>跑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>拜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bài</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>声<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>呼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hū</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>至<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>高<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāo</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>相<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>干<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡān</rt></ruby>？<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>指<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>恳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kěn</rt></ruby><ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>受<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shòu</rt></ruby><ruby>苦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǔ</rt></ruby>！”

<ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shì</rt></ruby><ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>曾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>吩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēn</rt></ruby><ruby>咐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>污<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wū</rt></ruby><ruby>鬼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>身<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>吧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bɑ</rt></ruby>！”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>问<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>名<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby>？”<ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Huí</rt></ruby><ruby>答<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dá</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>名<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby>‘<ruby>群<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Qún</rt></ruby>’，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>多<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duō</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>缘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuán</rt></ruby><ruby>故<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡù</rt></ruby>”；
