verses.text: <ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>同<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>暗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">àn</rt></ruby><ruby>暗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">àn</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>旷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>野<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>方<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fɑnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>歇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiē</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>歇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiē</rt></ruby>。”<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>往<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>多<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duō</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>连<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lián</rt></ruby><ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby><ruby>饭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fàn</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>工<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>夫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fu</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>坐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>船<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuán</rt></ruby>，<ruby>暗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">àn</rt></ruby><ruby>暗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">àn</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>往<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>旷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>野<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>方<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fɑnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>许<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>多<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duō</rt></ruby><ruby>认<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rèn</rt></ruby><ruby>识<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>各<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>城<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>步<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>同<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>跑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>比<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>先<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiān</rt></ruby><ruby>赶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>许<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>多<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duō</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>怜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lián</rt></ruby><ruby>悯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǐn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>同<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>羊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>牧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>般<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bān</rt></ruby>，<ruby>于<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>开<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kāi</rt></ruby><ruby>口<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>教<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>训<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xùn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>许<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>多<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duō</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>理<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tiān</rt></ruby><ruby>已<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>经<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>晚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>，<ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>徒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tú</rt></ruby><ruby>进<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>野<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiān</rt></ruby><ruby>已<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>经<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>晚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>请<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>散<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sàn</rt></ruby><ruby>开<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kāi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>往<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>四<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sì</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>乡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>村<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cūn</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>己<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>买<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><ruby>答<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dá</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby><ruby>吧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bɑ</rt></ruby>。”<ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mén</rt></ruby><ruby>徒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tú</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>买<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>二<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">èr</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>两<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>银<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yín</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>饼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby><ruby>吗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mɑ</rt></ruby>？”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>多<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duō</rt></ruby><ruby>少<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>饼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby>。”<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>五<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>饼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>两<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>条<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiáo</rt></ruby><ruby>鱼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>吩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēn</rt></ruby><ruby>咐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>，<ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>帮<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>帮<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>坐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>青<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>草<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>排<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pái</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>排<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pái</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>坐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby>，<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>百<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>排<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pái</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>五<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>排<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pái</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>拿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ná</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>五<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>饼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>两<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>条<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiáo</rt></ruby><ruby>鱼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby>，<ruby>望<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiān</rt></ruby><ruby>祝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>福<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby>，<ruby>擘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bāi</rt></ruby><ruby>开<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kāi</rt></ruby><ruby>饼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>递<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>徒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tú</rt></ruby>，<ruby>摆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby>，<ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>两<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>条<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiáo</rt></ruby><ruby>鱼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>分<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēn</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby>，<ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>且<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiě</rt></ruby><ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby><ruby>饱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>原<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuán</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>法<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>赛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sài</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>犹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yóu</rt></ruby><ruby>太<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tài</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>拘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jū</rt></ruby><ruby>守<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>古<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>遗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>传<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuán</rt></ruby>，<ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>仔<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>细<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xì</rt></ruby><ruby>洗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>手<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby><ruby>饭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fàn</rt></ruby>；

<ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>市<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>洗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>浴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yù</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby><ruby>饭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fàn</rt></ruby>；<ruby>还<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hái</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>些<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiē</rt></ruby><ruby>别<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bié</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>规<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuī</rt></ruby><ruby>矩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ju</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>历<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>代<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><ruby>拘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jū</rt></ruby><ruby>守<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>洗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>杯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bēi</rt></ruby>、<ruby>罐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuàn</rt></ruby>、<ruby>铜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>器<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qì</rt></ruby><ruby>等<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">děnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>物<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wù</rt></ruby>。）

<ruby>法<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Fǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>赛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sài</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>文<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wén</rt></ruby><ruby>士<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>问<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>徒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tú</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>照<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhào</rt></ruby><ruby>古<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>遗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>传<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuán</rt></ruby>，<ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>俗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sú</rt></ruby><ruby>手<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby><ruby>饭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fàn</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>赛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sài</rt></ruby><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yà</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>指<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>假<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>冒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mào</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>善<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shàn</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>预<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yù</rt></ruby><ruby>言<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yán</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>错<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cuò</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。<ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Rú</rt></ruby><ruby>经<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：‘<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>百<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>姓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>嘴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>唇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chún</rt></ruby><ruby>尊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zūn</rt></ruby><ruby>敬<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>却<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">què</rt></ruby><ruby>远<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>离<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lí</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>吩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēn</rt></ruby><ruby>咐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>理<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>教<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>导<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>拜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bài</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>枉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>然<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rán</rt></ruby>。’

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>离<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lí</rt></ruby><ruby>弃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qì</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>诫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiè</rt></ruby><ruby>命<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mìnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>拘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jū</rt></ruby><ruby>守<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>遗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>传<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuán</rt></ruby>”；

<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>诚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>然<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rán</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>废<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fèi</rt></ruby><ruby>弃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qì</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>诫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiè</rt></ruby><ruby>命<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mìnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>守<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>己<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>遗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>传<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuán</rt></ruby>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>摩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mó</rt></ruby><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：‘<ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>孝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiào</rt></ruby><ruby>敬<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>父<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>母<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǔ</rt></ruby>’；<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：‘<ruby>咒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhòu</rt></ruby><ruby>骂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mà</rt></ruby><ruby>父<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>母<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>治<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>。’

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>倒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：‘<ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Rén</rt></ruby><ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>父<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>母<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>奉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>已<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>经<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>各<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>耳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ěr</rt></ruby><ruby>板<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎn</rt></ruby>’（<ruby>各<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>耳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ěr</rt></ruby><ruby>板<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>供<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>献<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>意<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>思<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">si</rt></ruby>），

<ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>后<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>容<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>再<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>奉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>养<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>父<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>母<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǔ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>承<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>接<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiē</rt></ruby><ruby>遗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>传<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuán</rt></ruby>，<ruby>废<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fèi</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby>。<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>还<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hái</rt></ruby>做<ruby>许<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>多<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duō</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby>，<ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>明<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>白<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bɑi</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>外<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wài</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>进<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>污<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wū</rt></ruby><ruby>秽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huì</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>惟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>乃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>污<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wū</rt></ruby><ruby>秽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huì</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>。”（<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>古<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>卷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">juàn</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>此<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby>16“<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>耳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ěr</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>应<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby>！”）

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>离<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lí</rt></ruby><ruby>开<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kāi</rt></ruby><ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>进<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>屋<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wū</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>徒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tú</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>问<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>比<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>喻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yù</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>意<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>思<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">si</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>明<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>白<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bɑi</rt></ruby><ruby>吗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mɑ</rt></ruby>？<ruby>岂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>晓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>凡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fán</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>外<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wài</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>进<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>入<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rù</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>污<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wū</rt></ruby><ruby>秽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huì</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>入<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rù</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>乃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>入<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rù</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>肚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dù</rt></ruby><ruby>腹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>落<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">luò</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>茅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">máo</rt></ruby><ruby>厕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cè</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>（<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>，<ruby>各<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>食<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>物<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wù</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>洁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jié</rt></ruby><ruby>净<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>）”；

<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>才<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cái</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>污<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wū</rt></ruby><ruby>秽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huì</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>；

<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fā</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">è</rt></ruby><ruby>念<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niàn</rt></ruby>、<ruby>苟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>合<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby>、

<ruby>偷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tōu</rt></ruby><ruby>盗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby>、<ruby>凶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>杀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shā</rt></ruby>、<ruby>奸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby><ruby>淫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yín</rt></ruby>、<ruby>贪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tān</rt></ruby><ruby>婪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lán</rt></ruby>、<ruby>邪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xié</rt></ruby><ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">è</rt></ruby>、<ruby>诡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>诈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhà</rt></ruby>、<ruby>淫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yín</rt></ruby><ruby>荡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dànɡ</rt></ruby>、<ruby>嫉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jí</rt></ruby><ruby>妒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dù</rt></ruby>、<ruby>谤<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>讟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dú</rt></ruby>、<ruby>骄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiāo</rt></ruby><ruby>傲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ào</rt></ruby>、<ruby>狂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>妄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wànɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>切<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiè</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">è</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>且<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiě</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>污<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wū</rt></ruby><ruby>秽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huì</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>身<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>往<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǎnɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>推<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tuī</rt></ruby><ruby>罗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">luó</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xī</rt></ruby><ruby>顿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dùn</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>境<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>内<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nèi</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>进<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>家<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>愿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuàn</rt></ruby><ruby>意<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yi</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby>，<ruby>却<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">què</rt></ruby><ruby>隐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐn</rt></ruby><ruby>藏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby>。
verses.heading: 一个妇人的信心

verses.text: <ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby>，<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>妇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>她<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>小<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>女<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǚ</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>污<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wū</rt></ruby><ruby>鬼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>附<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhuó</rt></ruby>，<ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>俯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>伏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>脚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>妇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>希<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xī</rt></ruby><ruby>腊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">là</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>属<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǔ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>叙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xù</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>腓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">féi</rt></ruby><ruby>尼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ní</rt></ruby><ruby>基<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jī</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>族<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zú</rt></ruby>。<ruby>她<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>赶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>鬼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>离<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lí</rt></ruby><ruby>开<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kāi</rt></ruby><ruby>她<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>女<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǚ</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>她<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>让<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Rànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>女<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǚ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>先<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiān</rt></ruby><ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby><ruby>饱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎo</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>拿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ná</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>女<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǚ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>饼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>丢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diū</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>狗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>妇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Fù</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><ruby>答<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dá</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>错<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cuò</rt></ruby>；<ruby>但<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dàn</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>狗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>桌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhuō</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>底<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiɑ</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby><ruby>孩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hái</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>碎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suì</rt></ruby><ruby>渣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhā</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">er</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>她<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>句<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jù</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>吧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bɑ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>鬼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Guǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>已<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>经<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>离<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lí</rt></ruby><ruby>开<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kāi</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>女<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǚ</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>她<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><ruby>家<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>小<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>孩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hái</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>躺<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>床<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>鬼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>已<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>经<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>离<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lí</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>推<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tuī</rt></ruby><ruby>罗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">luó</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>境<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>界<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiè</rt></ruby>，<ruby>经<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xī</rt></ruby><ruby>顿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dùn</rt></ruby></mark>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>低<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dī</rt></ruby><ruby>加<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>波<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bō</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>境<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>内<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nèi</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>加<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby></mark> <mark class="pn"><ruby>海<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎi</rt></ruby></mark>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>领<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>离<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lí</rt></ruby><ruby>开<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kāi</rt></ruby><ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>边<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biān</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>指<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tou</rt></ruby><ruby>探<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tàn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>耳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ěr</rt></ruby><ruby>朵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duo</rt></ruby>，<ruby>吐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>唾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tuò</rt></ruby><ruby>沫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mo</rt></ruby><ruby>抹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>舌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shé</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tou</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>望<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiān</rt></ruby><ruby>叹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tàn</rt></ruby><ruby>息<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby>，<ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>法<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby>！”<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>开<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Kāi</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>吧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bɑ</rt></ruby>！”

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>耳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ěr</rt></ruby><ruby>朵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duo</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>开<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kāi</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>，<ruby>舌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shé</rt></ruby><ruby>结<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jié</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>解<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiě</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>，<ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>清<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>楚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chu</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>嘱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>咐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby><ruby>诉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">su</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>；<ruby>但<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dàn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>越<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuè</rt></ruby><ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fā</rt></ruby><ruby>嘱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>咐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>越<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuè</rt></ruby><ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fā</rt></ruby><ruby>传<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuán</rt></ruby><ruby>扬<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>开<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kāi</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>分<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fèn</rt></ruby><ruby>外<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wài</rt></ruby><ruby>希<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby><ruby>奇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby>，<ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby>做<ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎo</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>连<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lián</rt></ruby><ruby>聋<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>哑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>巴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bɑ</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nà</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby>，<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>许<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>多<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duō</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>聚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jù</rt></ruby><ruby>集<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jí</rt></ruby>，<ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>徒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tú</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：
verses.heading: 耶稣给四千人吃饱

verses.text: “<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>怜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lián</rt></ruby><ruby>悯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǐn</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>；<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>同<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>已<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>经<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>三<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sān</rt></ruby><ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiān</rt></ruby>，<ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>打<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fā</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>饿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">è</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><ruby>家<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>路<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>困<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kùn</rt></ruby><ruby>乏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fá</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>其<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>远<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>处<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chù</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mén</rt></ruby><ruby>徒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tú</rt></ruby><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><ruby>答<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dá</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zài</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>野<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>哪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>饼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>些<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiē</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby><ruby>饱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>问<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>多<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duō</rt></ruby><ruby>少<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shɑo</rt></ruby><ruby>饼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐnɡ</rt></ruby>？”<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>七<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Qī</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby>。”

<mark class="pn"><ruby>彼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>才<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cái</rt></ruby><ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎo</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>甚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shèn</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>惧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jù</rt></ruby><ruby>怕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pà</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>朵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>云<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yún</rt></ruby><ruby>彩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cɑi</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>遮<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhē</rt></ruby><ruby>盖<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡài</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>；<ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>声<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>音<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>云<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yún</rt></ruby><ruby>彩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cɑi</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>爱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ài</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mén</rt></ruby><ruby>徒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tú</rt></ruby><ruby>忽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hū</rt></ruby><ruby>然<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rán</rt></ruby><ruby>周<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōu</rt></ruby><ruby>围<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>再<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>只<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>同<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xià</rt></ruby><ruby>山<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shān</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby>，<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>嘱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>咐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Rén</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>还<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hái</rt></ruby><ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>复<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>活<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huó</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby><ruby>诉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">su</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mén</rt></ruby><ruby>徒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tú</rt></ruby><ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby><ruby>存<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cún</rt></ruby><ruby>记<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>彼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>此<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>议<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>论<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lùn</rt></ruby>“<ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>复<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>活<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huó</rt></ruby>”<ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>意<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>思<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">si</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>问<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèn</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>文<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wén</rt></ruby><ruby>士<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yà</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>须<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xū</rt></ruby><ruby>先<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiān</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>？”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yà</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>固<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡù</rt></ruby><ruby>然<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rán</rt></ruby><ruby>先<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiān</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>复<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>兴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>万<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wàn</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>；<ruby>经<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>指<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>受<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shòu</rt></ruby><ruby>许<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>多<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duō</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>苦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>轻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>慢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">màn</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby><ruby>诉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">su</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>，<mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yà</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>已<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>经<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>任<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rèn</rt></ruby><ruby>意<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>待<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>正<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>经<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>指<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>徒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tú</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>许<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>多<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duō</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>围<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>，<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>文<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wén</rt></ruby><ruby>士<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>辩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby><ruby>论<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lùn</rt></ruby>。
verses.heading: 治好被污鬼附身的孩子

<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nà</rt></ruby><ruby>鬼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>喊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby>，<ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>孩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hái</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>抽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chōu</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>阵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhèn</rt></ruby><ruby>风<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。<ruby>孩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Hái</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>像<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>般<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bān</rt></ruby>，<ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>致<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>多<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duō</rt></ruby><ruby>半<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bàn</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>但<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dàn</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lā</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>手<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>扶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>站<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhàn</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>进<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>屋<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wū</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>徒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tú</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>暗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">àn</rt></ruby><ruby>暗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">àn</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>问<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>赶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>非<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Fēi</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>祷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby>（<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>古<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>卷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">juàn</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>此<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby>“<ruby>禁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>食<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby>”<ruby>二<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">èr</rt></ruby><ruby>字<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby>），<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>类<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lèi</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>鬼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>总<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>（<ruby>或<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huò</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby>“<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>赶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>”）。”

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>离<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lí</rt></ruby><ruby>开<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kāi</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>方<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fɑnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>经<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>加<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby></mark>；<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>愿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuàn</rt></ruby><ruby>意<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby>。
