verses.text: <ruby>于<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>教<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>训<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xùn</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>徒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tú</rt></ruby>，<ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Rén</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>交<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiāo</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>手<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>杀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shā</rt></ruby><ruby>害<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hài</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>；<ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>杀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shā</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>后<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><ruby>三<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sān</rt></ruby><ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiān</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>复<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>活<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huó</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mén</rt></ruby><ruby>徒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tú</rt></ruby><ruby>却<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">què</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>明<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>白<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bɑi</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby>，<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>敢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>问<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>迦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>百<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>农<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nónɡ</rt></ruby></mark>。<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>屋<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wū</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>问<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèn</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>徒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tú</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>路<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>议<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>论<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lùn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby>？”
verses.heading: 谁最伟大

verses.text: <ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mén</rt></ruby><ruby>徒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tú</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>声<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>路<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>彼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>此<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>争<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>论<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lùn</rt></ruby><ruby>谁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuí</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>坐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby>，<ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>二<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">èr</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>徒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tú</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>愿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuàn</rt></ruby><ruby>意<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>首<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>先<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiān</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>末<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mò</rt></ruby><ruby>后<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>于<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>领<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>小<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>孩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hái</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>站<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhàn</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>徒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tú</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>间<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby>，<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>抱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bào</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：

“<ruby>凡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Fán</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>名<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>接<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiē</rt></ruby><ruby>待<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dāi</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>像<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>小<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>孩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hái</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>接<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiē</rt></ruby><ruby>待<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>凡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fán</rt></ruby><ruby>接<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiē</rt></ruby><ruby>待<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>接<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiē</rt></ruby><ruby>待<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>乃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>接<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiē</rt></ruby><ruby>待<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>差<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chāi</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。”

<mark class="pn"><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>翰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hàn</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>夫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Fū</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>奉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>名<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>赶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>鬼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>禁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>止<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>跟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡēn</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>。”
verses.heading: 不敌挡我们就是帮助我们

verses.text: <ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bú</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>禁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>止<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>；<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>奉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>名<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>异<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>反<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>倒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>轻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>易<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>毁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>谤<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bù</rt></ruby><ruby>敌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dí</rt></ruby><ruby>挡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>帮<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>助<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>凡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Fán</rt></ruby><ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>属<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>基<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jī</rt></ruby><ruby>督<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dū</rt></ruby>，<ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>杯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bēi</rt></ruby><ruby>水<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>喝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hē</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>实<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby><ruby>诉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">su</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>赏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>赐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cì</rt></ruby>。”

“<ruby>凡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Fán</rt></ruby><ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>信<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>小<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>跌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diē</rt></ruby><ruby>倒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>倒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>磨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mó</rt></ruby><ruby>石<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>拴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuān</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>颈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>项<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>扔<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>海<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>。

verses.text: <ruby>倘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>只<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>手<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>跌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diē</rt></ruby><ruby>倒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎo</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>它<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>砍<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>；

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>缺<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">quē</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>肢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>体<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>进<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>入<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rù</rt></ruby><ruby>永<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>强<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>两<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>只<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>手<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>落<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">luò</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>狱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>入<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rù</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>灭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miè</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>火<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>倘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>只<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>脚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>跌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diē</rt></ruby><ruby>倒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎo</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>它<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>砍<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>；

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>瘸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qué</rt></ruby><ruby>腿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>进<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>入<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rù</rt></ruby><ruby>永<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>强<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>两<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>只<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>脚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>丢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diū</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>狱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yù</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>倘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>只<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>眼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>跌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diē</rt></ruby><ruby>倒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎo</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>掉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diào</rt></ruby><ruby>它<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>；<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>只<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>只<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>眼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>进<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>入<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rù</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>国<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuó</rt></ruby>，<ruby>强<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>两<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>只<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>眼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>丢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diū</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>狱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yù</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zài</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>虫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>火<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>灭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miè</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>火<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>盐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yán</rt></ruby><ruby>腌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yān</rt></ruby><ruby>各<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>。（<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>古<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>卷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">juàn</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>此<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby>“<ruby>凡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fán</rt></ruby><ruby>祭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>物<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wù</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>盐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yán</rt></ruby><ruby>腌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yān</rt></ruby>”。）

<ruby>盐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yán</rt></ruby><ruby>本<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">běn</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>失<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shī</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>味<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>它<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>再<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>咸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xián</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tou</rt></ruby><ruby>应<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>盐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yán</rt></ruby>，<ruby>彼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>此<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>睦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>身<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>犹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yóu</rt></ruby><ruby>太<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tài</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>境<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>界<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiè</rt></ruby><ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>旦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dàn</rt></ruby><ruby>河<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>外<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wài</rt></ruby>。<ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>聚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jù</rt></ruby><ruby>集<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jí</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>照<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhào</rt></ruby><ruby>常<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>教<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>训<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xùn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>。
verses.heading: 休妻的问题

verses.text: <ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>法<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>赛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sài</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>问<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Rén</rt></ruby><ruby>休<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiū</rt></ruby><ruby>妻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qī</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby>？”<ruby>意<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yì</rt></ruby><ruby>思<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">si</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>试<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>探<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tàn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><ruby>答<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dá</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<mark class="pn"><ruby>摩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mó</rt></ruby><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>吩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēn</rt></ruby><ruby>咐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby>？”

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<mark class="pn"><ruby>摩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mó</rt></ruby><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>许<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>写<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiě</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>休<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiū</rt></ruby><ruby>书<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shū</rt></ruby><ruby>便<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>休<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiū</rt></ruby><ruby>妻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qī</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<mark class="pn"><ruby>摩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mó</rt></ruby><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>硬<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yìnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>写<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiě</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>条<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiáo</rt></ruby><ruby>例<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>；

<ruby>但<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dàn</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>初<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>创<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>造<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zào</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby>，　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>造<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zào</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>造<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zào</rt></ruby><ruby>男<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nán</rt></ruby><ruby>造<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zào</rt></ruby><ruby>女<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǚ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>此<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>离<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lí</rt></ruby><ruby>开<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kāi</rt></ruby><ruby>父<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>母<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǔ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>妻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qī</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>连<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lián</rt></ruby><ruby>合<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby>，<ruby>二<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">èr</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>成<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>体<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tǐ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>既<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jì</rt></ruby><ruby>然<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rán</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>此<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>夫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fū</rt></ruby><ruby>妻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qī</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>再<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>两<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>乃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>体<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby>，　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>配<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pèi</rt></ruby><ruby>合<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>分<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēn</rt></ruby><ruby>开<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kāi</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dào</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>屋<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wū</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>徒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tú</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>问<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>凡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Fán</rt></ruby><ruby>休<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiū</rt></ruby><ruby>妻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qī</rt></ruby><ruby>另<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>娶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>犯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fàn</rt></ruby><ruby>奸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby><ruby>淫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yín</rt></ruby>，<ruby>辜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡū</rt></ruby><ruby>负<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>妻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qī</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>；

<ruby>妻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qī</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>离<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lí</rt></ruby><ruby>弃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qì</rt></ruby><ruby>丈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>夫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fu</rt></ruby><ruby>另<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>嫁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jià</rt></ruby>，<ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>犯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fàn</rt></ruby><ruby>奸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby><ruby>淫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yín</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>带<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>小<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>孩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hái</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby>，<ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>摸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mō</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>，<ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>徒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tú</rt></ruby><ruby>便<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby><ruby>责<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zé</rt></ruby><ruby>备<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>些<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiē</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>。
verses.heading: 耶稣为小孩祝福

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>实<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby><ruby>诉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">su</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>，<ruby>凡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fán</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>承<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>受<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shòu</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>国<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuó</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>像<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>小<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>孩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hái</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>断<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duàn</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>进<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby>。<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>喝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hē</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>杯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bēi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>喝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hē</rt></ruby><ruby>吗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mɑ</rt></ruby>？<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>受<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shòu</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>洗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>受<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shòu</rt></ruby><ruby>吗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mɑ</rt></ruby>？”

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby>。”<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>喝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hē</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>杯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bēi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>喝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hē</rt></ruby>；<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>受<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shòu</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>洗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>受<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shòu</rt></ruby>；

<ruby>只<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>坐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>左<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>右<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>赐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cì</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>乃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>谁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuí</rt></ruby><ruby>预<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yù</rt></ruby><ruby>备<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>赐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cì</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>谁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuí</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nà</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>徒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tú</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>恼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>怒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nù</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>雅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>各<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>翰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hàn</rt></ruby></mark>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby>，<ruby>外<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wài</rt></ruby><ruby>邦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>尊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zūn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>君<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jūn</rt></ruby><ruby>王<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>治<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>理<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>，<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>臣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chén</rt></ruby><ruby>操<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cāo</rt></ruby><ruby>权<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">quán</rt></ruby><ruby>管<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>束<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shù</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>只<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>间<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby>。<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>间<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby>，<ruby>谁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuí</rt></ruby><ruby>愿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuàn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>；

<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>间<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby>，<ruby>谁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuí</rt></ruby><ruby>愿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuàn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>首<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>仆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pú</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>。

verses.text: <ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>拿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Ná</rt></ruby><ruby>撒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sā</rt></ruby><ruby>勒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>喊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<mark class="pn"><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dà</rt></ruby><ruby>卫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>孙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sūn</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>！<ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>怜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lián</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>吧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bɑ</rt></ruby>！”

<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>许<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>多<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duō</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>责<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zé</rt></ruby><ruby>备<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>许<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>声<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby>。<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>却<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">què</rt></ruby><ruby>越<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuè</rt></ruby><ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fā</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>声<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>喊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<mark class="pn"><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dà</rt></ruby><ruby>卫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>孙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sūn</rt></ruby><ruby>哪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>怜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lián</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>吧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bɑ</rt></ruby>！”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>站<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhàn</rt></ruby><ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>。”<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>瞎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiā</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>放<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Fànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>！<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>啦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lɑ</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>问<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèn</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>句<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jù</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><ruby>答<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dá</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby><ruby>诉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">su</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>仗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>权<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">quán</rt></ruby><ruby>柄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐnɡ</rt></ruby>做<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>些<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiē</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>翰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hàn</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>洗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>礼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiān</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>？<ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>间<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><ruby>答<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dá</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>彼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>此<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>商<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>议<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>‘<ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiān</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>’，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：‘<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>信<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？’

<ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>‘<ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>间<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>’，<ruby>却<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">què</rt></ruby><ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>怕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pà</rt></ruby><ruby>百<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>姓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>真<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhēn</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>翰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hàn</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>先<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiān</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>于<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><ruby>答<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dá</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby>。”<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby><ruby>诉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">su</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>仗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>权<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">quán</rt></ruby><ruby>柄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐnɡ</rt></ruby>做<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>些<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiē</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>比<rt verses.text: <ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dào</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby>，<ruby>打<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fā</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>仆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pú</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>园<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuán</rt></ruby><ruby>户<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hù</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>园<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuán</rt></ruby><ruby>户<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hù</rt></ruby><ruby>收<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shōu</rt></ruby><ruby>葡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pú</rt></ruby><ruby>萄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tɑo</rt></ruby><ruby>园<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuán</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>果<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>园<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuán</rt></ruby><ruby>户<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hù</rt></ruby><ruby>拿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ná</rt></ruby><ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>打<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>空<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>手<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>再<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zài</rt></ruby><ruby>打<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fā</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>仆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pú</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>。<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>打<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>伤<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tóu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>且<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiě</rt></ruby><ruby>凌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">línɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>辱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>打<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fā</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>仆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pú</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>杀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shā</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>。<ruby>后<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Hòu</rt></ruby><ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>打<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fā</rt></ruby><ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>些<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiē</rt></ruby><ruby>仆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pú</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>打<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>杀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。

verses.text: “<ruby>夫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Fū</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby>，<mark class="pn"><ruby>摩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mó</rt></ruby><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>写<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiě</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：‘<ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Rén</rt></ruby><ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>，<ruby>撇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">piě</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby><ruby>妻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qī</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>孩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hái</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>兄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>弟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>娶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>妻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qī</rt></ruby>，<ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>哥<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡē</rt></ruby><ruby>哥<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡe</rt></ruby><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>立<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>后<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby>。’

<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>弟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>兄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>七<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qī</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>第<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>娶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>妻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qī</rt></ruby>，<ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>，<ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>留<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liú</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby><ruby>孩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hái</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>第<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dì</rt></ruby><ruby>二<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">èr</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>娶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>她<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>，<ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>留<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liú</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby><ruby>孩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hái</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>。<ruby>第<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dì</rt></ruby><ruby>三<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sān</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nà</rt></ruby><ruby>七<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qī</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>留<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liú</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby><ruby>孩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hái</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>；<ruby>末<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mò</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liǎo</rt></ruby>，<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>妇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>复<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>活<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huó</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby>，<ruby>她<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>哪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>妻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qī</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>七<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qī</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>娶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><ruby>她<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>错<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cuò</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>，<ruby>岂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>明<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>白<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bɑi</rt></ruby><ruby>圣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>经<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>晓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>吗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mɑ</rt></ruby>？

<ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Rén</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>复<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>活<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huó</rt></ruby>，<ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>娶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>嫁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jià</rt></ruby>，<ruby>乃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>像<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiān</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>者<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhě</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>论<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Lùn</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>复<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>活<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huó</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>念<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niàn</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><mark class="_idGenRuby-3">Mó</rt></ruby><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：‘<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>伯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bó</rt></ruby><ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lā</rt></ruby><ruby>罕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎn</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby>，<mark <ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>乃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>活<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huó</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby>。<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>错<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cuò</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>文<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wén</rt></ruby><ruby>士<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>辩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby><ruby>论<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lùn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>晓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><ruby>答<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dá</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎo</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>问<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>诫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiè</rt></ruby><ruby>命<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>哪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>第<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>紧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？”
verses.heading: 最大的诫命

verses.text: <ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><ruby>答<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dá</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>第<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dì</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>紧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：‘<mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>色<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>独<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dú</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>尽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby>、<ruby>尽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>性<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìnɡ</rt></ruby>、<ruby>尽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>意<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby>、<ruby>尽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>力<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>爱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ài</rt></ruby><ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby>。’

<ruby>其<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Qí</rt></ruby><ruby>次<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cì</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：‘<ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yào</rt></ruby><ruby>爱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ài</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>己<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby>。’<ruby>再<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zài</rt></ruby><ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>比<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>两<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>条<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiáo</rt></ruby><ruby>诫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiè</rt></ruby><ruby>命<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>更<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>殿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diàn</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>教<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>训<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xùn</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>问<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>文<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wén</rt></ruby><ruby>士<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>怎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zěn</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>基<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jī</rt></ruby><ruby>督<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dū</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dà</rt></ruby><ruby>卫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>孙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sūn</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？
